notes.title: New Gameplay, Balanced Adjustments, and Enhanced Rewards Update
notes.content:
In this update, we have made several improvements to enhance your gaming experience:

[b]1.Optimized UI and User Interaction:[/b]
Streamlined the interface and improved the overall operation flow for a smoother and more intuitive gameplay experience.
Enhanced the startup screen with a fresh design and added a more detailed loading progress bar to keep you informed during game initialization.

[b]2.Adjusted Key Gameplay Values:[/b]
Tweaked the movement speed of the cat character for better balance and control, ensuring more precise movements in various scenarios.
Adjusted the movement speed, perception range, and behavior patterns of companions and other non-player-controlled cats, creating a more immersive and dynamic environment.
Fine-tuned additional key game parameters, including interaction timings and environmental responsiveness, to enhance playability and realism.

[b]3.Updated Coin Collection System:[/b]
Expanded coin distribution zones, ensuring a more balanced and engaging exploration experience across the map.
Introduced a new coin respawn mechanism, allowing coins to appear dynamically over time in diverse locations, encouraging players to explore more areas.
Added new methods for obtaining and collecting coins, providing players with more engaging, strategic, and rewarding opportunities.

We hope these updates provide a richer and more enjoyable experience. Your feedback is invaluable to us, and we look forward to hearing your thoughts!
